messages:
Anya Rodriguez: Quick post-game-day sync — can we capture the outstanding restore/backups/runbook action items in one place? I want owners + dates so we can close loop.
Devon Li: +1. I flagged a routing TTL edge that caused slow failback during the drill. Need a follow-up.
Samir Patel: I can take the routing TTL item. Proposal: shorten BGP session hold timers for the DR peer and document rollback steps.
Marta Gomez: From Support side — customers hit a short window where reads returned stale region replicas. We should add a customer-facing status blurb and playbook entry.
ops-bot: Snapshot completed for eu-west-1 cluster at 2023-10-12T07:12:03Z. snapshot-id: snap-20231012-eu.
Anya Rodriguez: Nice. OK here's a concise action list (feel free to edit):
1) Routing TTL and failback rollback steps — owner: Samir Patel — target: 2023-10-18 — notes: test in canary region.
2) Restore runbook: add k8s + PV steps + fast-path for partial restore — owner: Devon Li — target: 2023-10-20 — notes: include tl;dr commands.
3) Backup verification automation (daily smoke) — owner: Marta Gomez — target: 2023-10-25 — notes: surface failures in #incidents and create PagerDuty alert.
4) Customer status snippet + KB draft — owner: Support (Marta) — target: 2023-10-22 — notes: ready-to-paste text for status page.
5) Game-day cadence doc + owner rotation — owner: Anya Rodriguez — target: 2023-10-30 — notes: rotate every 6 weeks.
Devon Li: Adding runbook snippet for restore (put in the runbook repo):
```
# Restore partial region (pv-backed state)
kubectl -n redwood get pvc
kubectl -n redwood delete pod app-12345 --ignore-not-found
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/eu/2023-10-12/tarball.tar.gz - | tar xz -C /var/lib/app
# Restart statefulset
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart sts/app
```
Samir Patel: For the routing TTL item: I'll add test matrix entries: BGP hold 90s -> 30s, and simulated cross-region latency spikes. Plan a canary for 10/19.
Marta Gomez: For backup verification: I'll wire the daily smoke into the infra CI and post failures to #incidents. Need an action to add SLA thresholds.
Anya Rodriguez: Two process points: (a) please put final PRs into the runbook repo and tag "postmortem/2023-10-game-day" (b) I will run a brief owners rollcall next Tue 11:00am PT to confirm readiness.
Devon Li: I'll open the PR today and include the snippet + rollback note.
Samir Patel: I'll add the test harness and link results to the runbook.
Marta Gomez: Drafting the KB and status copy now, will ping for review.
Anya Rodriguez: Thanks. Can everyone drop a quick emoji when you push your PRs so I can track? :raised_hands:
Devon Li: :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: :white_check_mark:
Marta Gomez: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners rollcall on 2023-10-17 18:00 UTC.
Anya Rodriguez: That's it for now. If any blockers surface DM me. Closing thread once PRs merged and tests green.
